scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && tsc && vite build
scripts.lint: eslint src scripts tests packages/benchmark-contracts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.ci.config.ts vitest.setup.ts
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src scripts tests packages/benchmark-contracts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.ci.config.ts vitest.setup.ts --fix
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:checks && npm run test:coverage:run
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/package-tauri.test.mjs scripts/smoke-provider-runtime.test.mjs scripts/frontend-ci.test.mjs scripts/release-ci.test.mjs scripts/ci-rust-toolchain.test.mjs scripts/ci-workflow-contract.test.mjs scripts/native-build-inputs.test.mjs scripts/install-entrypoint.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:coverage:run
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test:checks: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:provider-options && npm run test:scripts
